document.about: IRS Form 8949 (2025), blank. Parts I and II each set a grid whose columns are keyed (a) to (h) in bold over their captions, and the page closes on a bold footer.

notes: #240: the grid's column keys, set bold in pairs, and the footer that refers the reader to the instructions were headings.

checks.issue: `(a) (b)`, two of the grid's column keys, was an h3.
The footer `For Paperwork Reduction Act Notice, see your tax return instructions.` was an h2.

element.text: For Paperwork Reduction Act Notice, see your tax return instructions.
